description: This header file declares functions related to managing the command name hierarchy in a process environment, including appending to the hierarchy, retrieving it, and releasing resources.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_append_hierarchy
methods.description: Appends the current command name to the hierarchy maintained in the environment.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_get_hierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves the current command name hierarchy for the process.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the command name hierarchy.
